sentences.en: The jeans looked none the cleaner for having been washed.
sentences.zh: 这条牛仔裤洗了也没见干净。

sentences.en: Meg was the only girl that was wearing jeans.
sentences.zh: 梅格是唯一一个穿着牛仔裤的女孩。

sentences.en: These jeans feel too tight. May I try on another size?
sentences.zh: 这条牛仔裤有点紧。我试试别的尺寸怎么样？

senses.zh: 牛仔裤Jeans琼斯(①姓氏 ②Sir James Hopwood, 1877-1946, 英国数学家, 物理学家, 天文学家)
